title: Plotting the Photons
tagline: Light orbiting a five-dimensional rotating black hole.
summary: Spherical photon orbits around a five-dimensional rotating (Myers-Perry) black hole: paths of light that stay at a fixed coordinate radius, are not confined to a plane, and can behave quasiperiodically. Based on the paper "Spherical Photon Orbits around a 5D Myers-Perry Black Hole" (General Relativity and Gravitation, 2018).
